scope: 50 individually described visitor-facing behavior and accessibility/privacy tasks in a cohesive Research Trail feature; not 50 independent apps or 50 research verifications.
originalData: 50 original records, all baseline HTML documents and legacy CSS preserved.
limitations: Browser storage may be unavailable; falls back to in-memory state
Shared links contain public record IDs only and require opt-in import
No account, syncing server or external submission inbox
Real devices and online detailed map tiles not independently verified
